description.p: A desktop system management dashboard for Ubuntu/Linux. Manage everything from one place:

ul.li: System overview — CPU, memory, uptime, OS/kernel info
Network — VPN, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, firewall, DNS, proxy
Hardware — battery, thermal, display, audio, mouse, storage
System — power, security, startup, users, appearance, locale
Tools — updates, logs, services, SSH keys, crontab

description.p: Built with Electron and Svelte 5, leveraging native system tools like nmcli, systemctl, gsettings, and ufw.
Initial release with 40 system management modules.
